content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 28.1.

- **Issue:** § 28.1 chooses Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales) and effectively walk-away territory as an exclusive foreign venue. It also directly contradicts § 28.2, which vests exclusive jurisdiction in the New York County state and federal courts.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** conform § 28.1 to New York law and New York County courts, changing only the jurisdiction and forum words and leaving the rest of the sentence intact.
- **Not flagged:** § 28.2 (already our preferred venue, with an acceptable interim-relief carve-out) and § 28.3 (pre-suit executive escalation that does not delay urgent relief or limitations filings).
